about: A compact summary for scripts. The main JSON files are tokens.<mode>.resolved.json (DTCG) and tokens.studio.json (Tokens Studio).
name: Pi Pocket
description: Pi Pocket's own design system: Tokyo Night in dark, a light day mode, and a high-contrast mode.

color.neutral.150.description: A half step, kept on purpose: the light mode's sunken well must be a shade darker than the canvas (100) and still hold muted text at 4.5:1, and 200 is too dark for that.

color.neutral.550.description: A half step, kept on purpose: the one gray that reaches 3:1 on a light ground and on a dark one, so a field border and a switch track use it in every mode.

color.neutral.750.description: A half step, kept on purpose: the dark mode needs a ground between surface (800) and selected (700) for what is raised.

color.alpha.scrim-dark.description: Dim layer behind sheets, on dark grounds.

color.alpha.scrim-light.description: Dim layer behind sheets, on light grounds.

color.bg.canvas.description: The desk behind everything. In high contrast, canvas, base, and sunken are one black: edges separate them, not tints.

color.bg.surface.description: Cards and panels on the ground.

color.bg.raised.description: Controls and anything lifted off a surface. In light mode it is the same white as surface: the shadow lifts it.

color.bg.selected.description: A selected row or segment: an accent tint in light mode, a lifted gray in dark and high contrast.

color.bg.sunken.description: Inset areas: code blocks and wells. A shade darker than the canvas in light mode; in high contrast it is the canvas black, and an edge sets it off.

color.bg.hover.description: Overlay on a hovered row or button.

color.bg.pressed.description: Overlay on a pressed row or button.

color.bg.scrim.description: The dim layer behind a sheet.

color.text.primary.description: Headings and the words that matter.

color.text.muted.description: Hints, timestamps, and secondary labels. Reads at 4.5:1 on every ground, a selected row too. In high contrast it is the same color as secondary, because it needs 7:1 there.

color.text.inverse.description: Text on a strong, neutral fill.

color.text.disabled.description: Disabled controls only. WCAG exempts disabled text from contrast, so it is below 4.5:1 on purpose: never use it for words that matter or for a placeholder.

color.border.subtle.description: A hairline between tiles and rows.

color.border.default.description: A visible line: cards and dividers.

color.border.strong.description: The edge of a field or a switch track. Reaches 3:1 on every ground.

color.accent.default.description: Links, icons, and accents on a ground.

color.accent.fill.description: The fill of a primary button.

color.accent.soft.description: A quiet accent wash behind selected things.

color.accent.line.description: The border of an accent wash.

color.danger.default.description: Errors and destructive actions. Text and icons.

color.danger.line.description: The border of a danger message.

color.danger.fill.description: The fill of a destructive button.

color.danger.fill-hover.description: The destructive fill under the pointer.

color.warning.default.description: Warnings and cautions. Text and icons.

color.warning.line.description: The border of a warning message.

color.success.default.description: Success and done. Text and icons.

color.success.line.description: The border of a success message.

color.info.default.description: Information and neutral notices. Text and icons.

color.info.line.description: The border of an info message.

color.code.bg.description: The ground of code: the same as the sunken well.

color.code.text.description: Code without a color of its own.

font.family.mono.description: Code, paths, branches, numbers, counts, and keys. Ligatures off, as in a terminal.
font.family.mono.value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

radius.scale.xs.description: State squares and the smallest marks.

radius.scale.sm.description: Inline code, keys, tags, and segments.

radius.scale.xl.description: Sheets, the message box, and pop-ups.

radius.seg.description: A segment in its track. The app uses 5 px; here 4 px, on the scale.

radius.control.description: Icon buttons, fields, segmented tracks. The app uses 7 px; here 6 px, on the scale.

radius.window.description: Windows, approval cards, peek tiles. The app uses 10 px; here 8 px, the same as a card.

radius.sheet.description: The message box, sheets, the launcher.

radius.float.description: Pop-ups and menus. The same step as a sheet; kept apart so that floating things can be rounded on their own.

size.tap.description: The smallest touch target on a touch screen.

shadow.lift.description: A soft lift: the message box.

shadow.float.description: What floats over the page: pop-ups, sheets, the launcher.

shadow.hairline.description: A 1 px outline drawn as a shadow, so layout does not move.

shadow.focus-ring.description: The keyboard focus ring: a soft halo around a solid line. Keep it visible.

type.display.description: Page titles and the home screen.

type.title.description: A screen or a sheet title.

type.code.value: 400 13px/1.55 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

type.code-sm.value: 400 12px/1.55 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

motion.ease.in-out.description: Things that move across the screen.

button.focus-offset.description: The gap between a button and its focus ring.

segmented.gap.description: The gap between segments, and around them.

badge.padding-y.description: The vertical padding of a badge.

badge.dot.description: The status dot in a badge.

menu.padding.description: The padding of a menu around its rows.
